title: On Promising to answer before the holiday
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：promise　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 promise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the foreman ① promised to answer before the holiday twice over, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② promises to answer before the holiday year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ promise to answer before the holiday at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ promised to answer before the holiday before — a line in the sheet for May 1971 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Promising to answer before the holiday twice over, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ promise a good year for the orchards year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Promise a good year for the orchards at once and never mention it again.

By 1984 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ promises a good year for the orchards twice over every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ promised to answer before the holiday again when nobody else would.

⑩ To promise to answer before the holiday, my mother said in 1989, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody promises to answer before the holiday year after year again and somebody must promise to answer before the holiday twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 允诺（一般过去式 promised to answer before the holiday：1977 年工头头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 允诺（一般现在 promises to answer before the holiday：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 允诺（不定式 to promise to answer before the holiday：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 允诺（过去完成时 had promised to answer before the holiday：1971 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 允诺（动名词 promising to answer before the holiday 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 预示（promise a good year for the orchards：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去预示预示着果园有个好年景）
G. v. 预示（promise a good year for the orchards：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 允诺（后段两处：新来的工人照例 promises a good year for the orchards，而母亲又一次 promised to answer before the holiday）

answers.why: promise 意为“允诺”，1977 年工头来回两遍允诺答应过节前回信，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 promised。
promise 意为“允诺”，自那以后工头年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 promises。
promise 意为“允诺”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯允诺答应过节前回信”，此处为不定式 to promise to answer before the holiday。
promise 意为“允诺”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1984 年之前就有人允诺过，故用过去完成时 had promised。
promise 意为“允诺”，工头说“允诺答应过节前回信这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 promising to answer before the holiday 作主语。
promise 意为“预示”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去预示预示着果园有个好年景”，should ever 之后用原形 promise a good year for the orchards。
promise 意为“预示”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻预示预示着果园有个好年景（promise a good year for the orchards at once），以后再也不要提起。
promise 意为“允诺”，新来的工人每个班次都照例预示预示着果园有个好年景，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 promises。
promise 意为“允诺”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍允诺答应过节前回信，用一般过去式 promised 叙述。
promise 意为“允诺”，结尾那句是母亲 1989 年的话：要允诺答应过节前回信，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 promise 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the foreman promised to answer before the holiday twice over, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman promises to answer before the holiday year after year whenever the site asks.
Promising to answer before the holiday twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever promise a good year for the orchards year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site promises a good year for the orchards twice over every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother promised to answer before the holiday again, and the site remembered that half.
